business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ocean Vessel Freight and Wholesale Distribution of Hydraulic Cement

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (common-law legal heritage with local statutory and customary land-law modifications)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty in force for International Companies
Samoa – Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement
Samoa – New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force since 13 December 2020

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, read together with the Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2003 (Samoa) and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended; beneficial ownership duties further imposed by the anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing regulations and directives issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar of International Companies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority in country of origin, with apostille by the competent authority or notarization by a notary public for consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank of the relevant individual, with notarization and apostille/consular certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banker's reference letter confirming financial standing and source of initial deposit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Certified Incorporation Documents of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and corporate structure chart executed by each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant or licensed registered agent in Samoa, with notarized signatures where required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed shareholders, directors, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit sanctions list implementing United Nations Security Council resolutions, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation Consolidated List, and the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database. Politically Exposed Persons are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring. High-risk jurisdictions trigger additional corroborative evidence and senior management approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry operated by the Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, with electronic filing channeled through licensed international company service providers
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Companies Act 1987 permits names in English or Samoan using the Latin alphabet; a romanized transliteration is required where the proposed name is derived from another script; the name must not be misleadingly identical or deceptively similar to any existing or reserved name in the Republic of Samoa registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 business days of a name rejection, the applicant must file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, attaching the original rejection notice, a statutory explanation of availability or distinctiveness, and documentary consent from the competent sectoral authority for any sensitive token. If the Registrar does not rescind the rejection, the applicant may offer two approved alternative names or pursue judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa. No extension of the 30-day initial reservation is available after expiry; a fresh reservation application and fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or mail-forwarding address is not acceptable for a Samoa International Company; a physical Samoan registered office operated by a licensed registered agent is mandatory. For the proposed wholesale cement distribution business, no local employees or physical inventory are required, but a non-resident wholesale International Company may use a licensed management company's premises as its registered address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 2% per annum for a low-risk International Company engaged solely in ocean vessel freight and wholesale distribution of Portland cement without local commercial presence; unannounced on-site inspection risk increases to moderate where the registered agent exhibits repeated compliance deficiencies or where adverse PEP/sanctions flags arise.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee benchmark reflecting Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening using global watchlist databases and Samoa FIU list verification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Third-party commercial database licensing fee benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document statutory notarial tariff and apostille certificate fees as applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for insured international document delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 6-12 (incorporation by registration), s. 12 (registered office), ss. 22-23 (officers), s. 117 (tax exemption status)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company (Form IC-1) filed together with the Notice of Registered Office (Form IC-2) and Notice of Directors and Officers (Form IC-3)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is mandatory; shares may be issued with no par value and in any currency. Capital duty is exempted. Escrow deposit rules apply only where a financier requires a bankable asset guarantee; such escrow is held with a licensed commercial bank in Samoa and is not a statutory incorporation condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers hereby form an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 of Samoa, and that the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the form filed with the Registrar are adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company shall be at the address of the registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that [Registered Agent] is appointed as registered agent. RESOLVED FURTHER that the initial subscribers shall subscribe to the issued shares set forth in the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name of CEO], [Name of Secretary], and [Name of Treasurer] are hereby appointed as the first directors and officers of the Company, each with authority to execute banking and contractual documents, effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Search and Reservation of the International Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Registry of International Companies — online name-reservation portal and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-reservation request offering up to three proposed names with the suffix 'Limited' or 'IC'. The Registry searches the International Companies Register and the reserved-names list. Upon approval, the name is reserved for three months; upon refusal, substitute names are processed automatically without a fresh fee.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (2-3 alternatives)
Corporate objects summary (wholesale distribution of construction materials, ISIC 4663)
Name reservation application form (Form IC-N1) signed by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, file an objection or submit revised names; resubmission is processed within one business day without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Notarization, and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act 1987 and a notary public in Samoa or the subscriber's jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the statutory model of the International Companies Act. Subscribers execute the M&A before a notary, confirming the subscribed share quantum (no minimum capital). The notarized deed and certified identity copies are delivered to the registered agent for filing.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified passport copy of each subscriber/shareholder
Proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
Signed consent to act as director/officer from each appointee
Bank reference report for anti-money-laundering compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the registered agent identifies a defect in execution, a supplementary executed deed is prepared and re-notarized; any correction is filed as an amendment to the M&A before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia counter or agent-facilitated e-filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits Form IC-1 together with the notarized M&A, Form IC-2 (registered office confirmation), and Form IC-3 (appointment of directors and officers). The Registrar verifies statutory compliance, reserves the corporate number, and approves the incorporation for certificate issuance.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 application for incorporation
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form IC-2 Notice of Registered Office
Form IC-3 Notice of Directors and Officers
Signed consent-to-act forms of all appointees
Beneficial ownership KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or query, the agent responds in writing within 14 days; required amendments are made by supplementary deed and refiled. Failure to cure results in refusal with a refund of the fee less administrative charges; a fresh application may then be submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Settlement of Filing Fee, Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation, and Registration of Tax-Exempt Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA treasury fee office and the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official state filing fee of USD 200 and the SIFA annual licence fee at the SIFA treasury window. Upon confirmation of payment, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique registration number. The company automatically holds International Company tax-exempt status; a Certificate of Good Standing may be requested at the same time.
required_dossiers: Fee remittance receipt
Issued Certificate of Incorporation (upon registry approval)
Registered agent's certificate of compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed beyond the SLA, the agent files an expedited follow-up with the Registrar; any clerical error on the certificate is corrected through a Certificate of Rectification within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ratification of First Board Resolution, Registered Office Activation, and Corporate Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors, the licensed registered agent, and a licensed commercial bank in Samoa (e.g., ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the First Board Meeting to adopt the pro-forma board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, officer appointments, and banking mandates. Present the corporate kit to the bank and open the account for Swift_LC and TT_Wire payment rails. If port-side storage is later established, apply for the MNRE/PUMA environmental registration and FESA fire safety certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
First Board Resolution (minutes)
Identity and address proofs of directors and officers
Bank account opening forms and KYC questionnaire
Certificate of Good Standing (recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises a KYC query, provide an enhanced corporate structure chart and a source-of-funds declaration; if environmental registration becomes applicable, file the PUMA registration application and satisfy any mitigation conditions within the prescribed compliance schedule.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Business Licence Desk; Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) for International Company status; Customs and Excise Division of the Ministry for Revenue for import clearance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating or manufacturing licence is statutorily mandated for a pure wholesale import-distribution International Company under ISIC 4663; operations require only customs import clearance for Portland clinker and, where a bonded transit warehouse is used, a warehouse licence from the Ministry for Revenue.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Low Impact) / Preliminary Environmental Assessment; a full EIA Report is triggered only if a permanent storage terminal, wharf-side handling facility, or cement packaging plant is developed in a coastal or environmentally sensitive zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 and Waste Management Regulations 2013; total suspended particulate (cement/clinker dust) at the property boundary must remain below 50 mg/m³; wastewater from any handling area must follow a nil-discharge rule with spill containment, and dust control measures (water suppression or baghouse filters) are required during bulk transfer.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) for any transit warehouse; structural load inspection by the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) for racking or storage platforms; occupational health and safety clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 covering dust exposure monitoring, personal protective equipment, and emergency response planning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa; online portal: MfR Tax Administration System (https://www.revenue.gov.ws). Offshore company registrar: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from national income tax, VAGST, and stamp duty on offshore operations under the International Companies Act 1987 (s.203), and therefore does not obtain an income tax TIN. Formation is completed with SIFA, which issues a Certificate of Incorporation and IC registration number. If the IC carries on a taxable activity within Samoa with turnover exceeding SAT 80,000 per 12 months, it must register for VAGST with the MfR on the prescribed form (supported by the SIFA certificate, memorandum and articles, and registered agent confirmation) and receive a TIN. A purely offshore IC trading cement clinker by ocean vessel is outside the VAGST registration net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no check-the-box or hybrid branch election. An IC may voluntarily convert to an Ordinary Company under the Companies Act 2001 (with SIFA and MfR notifications), thereby electing into Samoa corporate income tax (27%) and VAGST (15%). The Tax Administration Act 2012 and Samoa's OECD BEPS-aligned provisions, including its MLI position, govern hybrid mismatch outcomes; no elective multi-jurisdictional classification regime is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 80,000 per rolling 12-month period on taxable supplies made in Samoa (compulsory registration); voluntary registration available below the threshold; an IC with exclusively offshore exports of clinker has no domestic nexus and is not registrable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping mandate exists in Samoa. VAGST returns and payments are filed electronically through the MfR Tax Administration System. Commercial invoices, packing lists, and negotiable ocean bills of lading constitute the operative documentation; no government-approved e-invoicing platform is required for bulk clinker export sales.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAGST Act 1996, a registered person may apply the 0% rate to goods exported from Samoa where the goods are exported within the statutory period (generally 30 days from supply, or such time as the Commissioner allows) and documentary proof of export is retained. Bulk Portland cement clinker exported by ocean vessel qualifies as exported goods. Services rendered to non-residents for the offshore storage, handling, and freight of clinker are zero-rated where the services are supplied and performed outside Samoa. An exempt IC transacting offshore is outside VAGST entirely and is not required to file export refund claims.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Certificate of Origin (where preferential claims are made)
Loading port weight certificate and vessel manifest extract
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Tax Administration Act 2012, shortfall penalties reach 100% of the tax evaded for deliberate conduct and 150% for deliberate and concealed conduct, plus a late payment penalty of 2% per month and statutory interest; criminal prosecution may lead to fines and imprisonment. VAGST refunds attributable to zero-rated exports are subject to pre-payment and post-payment audit; any amount wrongfully refunded is clawed back with interest and penalties. SIFA may strike an IC off the register for breach of the International Companies Act 1987, and the IC exemption is forfeited where the entity engages in non-licensed domestic activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984. Exchange control is administered by the Central Bank under the Exchange Control Act 1977 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1978, with day-to-day powers delegated to authorized dealers (licensed commercial banks). The International Company (IC) is held to be a non-resident entity for exchange-control purposes under the International Companies Act 1987, and is regulated for corporate-law purposes by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) through its licensed registered agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government License Fee Renewal (International Company, authorized-capital fee tier)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed calendar date; renewal falls due on the anniversary of the date of incorporation, with a 30-day grace period for filing the annual return and paying the annual fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee is levied for each period of default; failure to pay within the anniversary quarter suspends the company's certificate of good standing; non-payment for 12 consecutive months empowers the Registrar to strike the International Company off the International Companies Register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Continuation Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Samoa registered agent or trust company (private service contract; confirmation retained for Registrar inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the incorporation anniversary date each year, aligned with the annual return renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and a registered office in Samoa is a continuing contravention of the International Companies Act 1987; the Registrar may after due notice cancel the company's incorporation if the default is not cured

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Statutory Register Re-Confirmation to Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Samoa registered agent (record-keeping obligation under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017 and International Companies Act 1987)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date; any share transfer or director change requires a register update within 14 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or outdated beneficial ownership and register records expose the company and its officers to fines under Samoa AML/CFT legislation and may invalidate the agent's annual compliance certification, triggering loss of good standing

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Standard International Companies are statutorily exempt from audit. A mandatory independent audit applies only to Permit Companies (banks, insurers, trust or financial services licensees) or when shareholders holding at least 25% of voting rights demand an audit in writing; an audited account is also required if the shareholders dispense with the audit under the solvency declaration conditions and the company fails to remain solvent
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS, as adopted in Samoa; International Companies are not obligated to file financial statements in Samoa unless an audit-trigger event occurs

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa does not maintain a public UBO registry. The registered agent is required to hold verified beneficial ownership data obtained through AML/KYC due diligence and to re-confirm such data annually on the incorporation anniversary. Any share transfer must be entered in the Register of Members, with the agent's beneficial ownership records updated within 14 days of the transfer; directors and the company secretary must likewise be re-confirmed to the agent each year
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book
Register of Charges, Register of Secretaries (if appointed)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,500 per year depending on the licensed trust company and service tier
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Exempt by default; voluntary independent audit or practical-means review USD 2,000 - 5,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% for resident companies (Samoa Income Tax Act 2015); 0% for International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act 2008
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: ICs are statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, stamp duty, and estate duty; no taxable income arises on worldwide profits of an IC provided it refrains from domestic trade; no filing of CIT return required for ICs

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (Form A1) filed electronically via the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) through the licensed Registered Agent; the domestic resident company return is the Income Tax Return for Companies (Form CIT-1) filed through the Ministry for Revenue (MfR) online portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual for both IC annual return and (where applicable) domestic CIT return; CIT instalments are quarterly for domestic taxpayers
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: IC Annual Return: within six months after the anniversary of incorporation or, if different, the company's financial year end; domestic CIT return: no later than six months after the end of the fiscal year (30 June for a 31 December year end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert statutory IC name and number exactly as registered; no tax declaration is required because the entity is tax-exempt

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa and registered agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the licensed agent's address; cannot be a P.O. box; a Samoa-registered agent is mandatory for non-resident owners

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and secretary names, nationalities and residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may be listed; at least one director or the secretary must be a Samoa resident natural person or a licensed trustee company

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, currency and class of shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State minimum issued capital (commonly one US$1 share); no minimum capital requirement; bearer shares are prohibited

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act and confirmation of no domestic trading activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director or secretary; false declarations trigger criminal penalties and director liability

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 through Box 6 (Form CIT-1, domestic resident companies only)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross business income, allowable deductions, taxable income, tax at 27%, instalment credits, net balance payable or refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ICs should not complete CIT-1; a Samoan IC earning no Samoa-source income is outside the CIT net. If an IC inadvertently derives Samoa-source income from prohibited domestic activity, full CIT reporting at 27% plus penalties applies and the IC must be re-baselined or deregistered

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of IC Annual Return: penalty up to WST 1,000 plus WST 20 per day of continuing default, late registration fees surcharge of 10% per month, and strike-off from the Register; late filing of a domestic CIT return: 10% of unpaid tax (minimum WST 200), 1.5% monthly default interest, and a further WST 100 per month up to WST 1,000; directors who knowingly cause late filing incur personal fines

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by an International Company; dividends paid to non-residents by a resident company are not subject to Samoan withholding tax when not attributable to a permanent establishment in Samoa
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa has a minimal treaty network and no comprehensive DTA with major capital exporting jurisdictions; for any treaty that does apply, the payor must obtain the non-resident recipient's Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the residence jurisdiction, submit a declaration of beneficial ownership to the Ministry for Revenue, and claim reduced WHT at or before payment; for ICs, no DTA relief is required because distributions are statutorily exempt; beneficial owners should obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption from the Samoa International Finance Authority to facilitate clean wire transfers through correspondent banks
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid by a resident company to a non-resident: statutory final WHT 15%; royalties paid to a non-resident: statutory final WHT 15%; payments made by an International Company to non-residents are exempt from Samoan WHT; treaty rates, where any treaty applies, would be 0% or reduced but are not practically available in most jurisdictions

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 5,000,000 aggregate annual related-party transactions (goods, services, financing or IP) triggers mandatory contemporaneous TP documentation (Local File) for domestic CIT filers; no TP documentation threshold applies to exempt ICs because they are outside the CIT net, but the IC must be able to demonstrate arm's length conduct if it transacts with related parties that claim deductions abroad
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2020 apply to International Companies engaged in relevant activities, including 'distribution and service centres'; the IC must maintain real economic presence in Samoa: local management and board meetings, adequate physical premises, full-time employees proportionate to the distribution activity, and core income-generating activities conducted in Samoa; an annual economic substance declaration must be filed with the Registrar through the registered agent within 12 months of the financial year end; pure holding or low-risk procurement structures without local staff and premises will fail the substance test and face sanctions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilfully misrepresenting the IC's activities in the annual return, failing to disclose a related party that conducts domestic Samoan trade, or knowingly omitting income that would render the IC no longer tax-exempt
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upon conviction: fine up to WST 500,000 and imprisonment up to seven years; the court may also order recovery of any tax that would have been payable plus interest and a penalty of 150% of the evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the tax, penalties and costs if they signed false declarations; a director guilty of tax evasion may be disqualified from acting as a director in Samoa for up to five years, subjected to a travel ban, and imprisoned for up to seven years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a paper entity with no employees, premises or active management in Samoa while carrying on a distribution and service centre business, or failing to file the annual economic substance declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty up to WST 100,000 for the company; repeated non-compliance results in automatic strike-off, compulsory winding up, and forfeiture of the exemption certificate; the registered agent must file a compliance report and may be fined WST 10,000 per non-compliant client
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow a substance failure are jointly and severally liable for the penalty and the costs of winding up; they may be prohibited from incorporating or managing any Samoa entity for up to five years and may be required to post security before leaving Samoa

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC for wire transfers, trade invoices, or trade-based money laundering related to cement transactions that involve proceeds of crime, false invoicing, over/under-invoicing of clinker shipments, or concealment of beneficial ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa's AML/CFT Act 2018: on conviction, imprisonment up to fourteen years and a fine up to WST 1,000,000; the company's bank accounts are subject to freezing and forfeiture of the proceeds; the IC's registration may be cancelled if its agent fails to conduct customer due diligence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face extradition-compliant criminal liability, personal asset forfeiture, travel bans pending trial, and civil restitution orders; directors who fail to maintain adequate beneficiary records are personally fined up to WST 50,000 and disqualified from holding any financial services licence

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Domestic Trading / Breach of IC Act 2008
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on business with Samoan residents, holding in Samoa real property or land, or engaging in banking/insurance activities for which the IC is not licensed, while marketing itself as a wholly exempt offshore vehicle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The offending contract is void and unenforceable in Samoa; the IC is liable to a fine up to WST 25,000 plus forfeiture of any profit derived from the prohibited transaction; the Registrar may strike off the IC and impose a lifetime ban on re-registration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for all debts arising from the void contract and for restitution to the Samoan counterparty; knowing breach is a criminal offence carrying imprisonment up to two years and a personal fine up to WST 25,000; the director may be subject to a garnishee order on overseas assets through reciprocal enforcement
